description_en: Starts a data migration task of Data Transmission Service (DTS)
kebab_example: aliyun dts start-migration-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --migration-job-id dtss0611o8vv900000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartMigrationJob
